canvas.title: Onboarding - Alex, Stockholm
canvas.markdown:
Welcome to Northpeak Stockholm, Alex. This is your onboarding guide for the first week. Read it before your first shift, then tap **Complete onboarding checklist** at the top of this channel.

> :star: **Start here.** Work down the page. Tick things off as you go. If you get stuck, ask Sam in this channel.

## :wave: You, this week

You are a seasonal sales associate at the Stockholm store. You started Monday. Black Friday weekend is Friday to Sunday, and the Trailhead insulated jacket is **30% off**.

- **Store:** Northpeak Stockholm
- **Your manager:** Sam, store manager
- **Your channels:** this onboarding channel, ![](#C0CGZ9TLWMS), and ![](#C0CGQ9YNNF7)
- **First shift:** Thursday buddy shift, then the Friday open

## :white_check_mark: Before you start

- [x] Slack account is set up
- [x] Till training is booked
- [x] Buddy shift is booked for Thursday
- [ ] Read this guide, including the Black Friday playbook
- [ ] Walk the floor with your buddy and learn the fire exits
- [ ] Tap **Complete onboarding checklist** in this channel

## :calendar: Your first week

| Day | What you do |
| --- | --- |
| **Monday** | Start day. Account, store tour, meet Sam. |
| **Tuesday** | Till training with your buddy. Learn a sale, a return, and a size check. |
| **Wednesday** | Shadow shift on the floor. Fold, greet, and refill the front rails. |
| **Thursday** | Buddy shift. You take the first customers, with your buddy beside you. |
| **Friday** | Black Friday open. Doors at **09:00**. Promo rails are yours to keep full. |
| **Saturday** | Full promo day. Same playbook as Friday. |
| **Sunday** | Last promo day. Help close the floor and note what ran out. |

## :busts_in_silhouette: Who to ask

Questions about your shifts, the till, or a customer go to your manager, Sam, in this channel.

- **On the floor:** the shift lead named in ![](#C0CGZ9TLWMS) that morning.
- **The promo plan:** Jordan, regional ops, posts it in ![](#C0CGZ9TLWMS). You do not need to message Jordan directly.
- **Company news:** ![](#C0CGQ9YNNF7). Read it. You rarely need to post there.
- **Anything you are unsure about:** ask in this channel. There are no silly questions in week one.

## :department_store: The store

The shop floor is one room with a backroom behind the staff door.

- **Front rails:** new and promo product. This is what customers see first. Keep them full and faced.
- **Back wall:** core jackets and boots, including the Trailhead jacket before it moves forward for the weekend.
- **Till bank:** tills 1 to 4. Tills 1 and 2 are the ones you will use this week.
- **Staff door:** backroom, lockers, and the break corner. Customers do not come through here.
- **Fire exits:** front doors, and the rear exit at the back of the stockroom. Your buddy will walk both with you.

### :clock3: Trading hours this week

- Monday to Thursday: **10:00 to 19:00**
- Friday to Sunday: **09:00 to 19:00**
- Be on the floor **15 minutes** before the doors open.

## :shopping_bags: On the floor

1. Greet the customer before they reach the rail.
2. Ask what they are looking for, then the activity: hiking, commuting, or cold weather.
3. Offer two options, not the whole wall.
4. Check the size in the backroom before you promise it.
5. Walk them to a till. Do not point across the floor.

### :credit_card: The till

- [ ] Watch a full sale
- [ ] Watch a return
- [ ] Take a sale yourself, with your buddy beside you
- [ ] Find a size that is not on the rail

If the card machine fails, stay with the customer and call the shift lead. Do not restart the till yourself.

## :label: Black Friday playbook

Friday to Sunday. The Trailhead insulated jacket is **30% off**. Promo stock lives on the **front rails**. Keep them full.

- Face the rail whenever you pass it. Sizes run small on the left, large on the right.
- M and L are the sizes that sell through first. Check those before you check anything else.
- If a promo line is running low, **check the backroom first**.
- If the backroom is empty, raise it with **Report low stock** in ![](#C0CGZ9TLWMS). Include the sizes, whether the backroom is empty, and how many customers have asked.
- You stay in the store channel. Regional ops picks it up from there.

> :package: **On the day.** Doors at 09:00. Tills 1 to 4 open. Your job is the front rail and a calm till, not the stockroom count.

## :helmet_with_white_cross: Health and safety

- [ ] Walk both fire exits with your buddy
- [ ] Know where the first aid kit is: staff door, left shelf
- [ ] Keep fire exits and aisles clear, including during the promo
- [ ] Boxes go to the backroom, not the shop floor
- [ ] Lift with a second person once a box is above waist height
- [ ] Report any hazard to the shift lead straight away, then tell Sam in this channel

If someone is hurt, stay with them and send a colleague for the shift lead. Do not move them.

## :coffee: A normal shift

1. **Arrive.** Locker, name badge, read ![](#C0CGZ9TLWMS) for the day's note.
2. **Open.** Rails faced, tills awake, exits clear.
3. **Floor.** Greet, size, refill. Check the promo rail each hour over the weekend.
4. **Break.** 20 minutes in the morning, 30 minutes for lunch. The shift lead sends you.
5. **Close.** Recover the rails, tell the shift lead what ran low, and head out.

## :round_pushpin: Good to know

- **What to wear:** dark trousers and the Northpeak fleece. Name badge on the left.
- **Phone:** yours stays in your locker, except to use Slack for this guide and the low-stock workflow.
- **Staff purchase:** ask Sam after your first week. Not during Black Friday weekend.
- **If you are running late:** message Sam in this channel before you are due on the floor.
- **If you are ill:** message Sam as soon as you know. Do not post it in the store channel.

---

:white_check_mark: When this page is done, tap **Complete onboarding checklist** at the top of the channel. Sam will see it.

limits: Frontline Members cannot use Slackbot, create canvases or lists, or start huddles.
Frontline Members can run workflows and open content a Full Member shares in their channels.
Slackbot stays on Sam and Jordan.
Do not show or claim QR sign-in, native shift scheduling, or off-shift blocking.
checks: The Frontline add-on is on, and Alex is a Frontline Member.
I've read the guide and Report low stock work as Alex on a phone.

Beat 1 is pre-recorded as a fallback.
Sam and Jordan use separate Chrome profiles, and phone mirroring has been tested.

manualSteps.title: Install the workspace app on the Enterprise Grid org
manualSteps.detail: Create a Slack app from slack/manifest.json and install it on the Enterprise Grid org, not on a single workspace. Grant it to workspaces created later, and approve it if an admin must. Reinstall after a manifest change so the new scopes are granted. This app creates the workspace, invites users, and stages channels. People do not message it.

manualSteps.title: Store the org-admin Slack token
manualSteps.detail: Keep the org-admin user token in the coding agent's secret store as SLACK_ADMIN_TOKEN. The shared cast is Alex, Sam, Jordan, Riley, Casey, and Jamie. Persona tokens use SLACK_TOKEN_ALEX, SLACK_TOKEN_SAM, SLACK_TOKEN_JORDAN, SLACK_TOKEN_RILEY, SLACK_TOKEN_CASEY, and SLACK_TOKEN_JAMIE. Reuse these users for later demos. Keep the tokens out of git.

manualSteps.title: Make Alex a Frontline Member
manualSteps.detail: Turn on the Frontline add-on. Alex is a Frontline Member with exactly #onboarding-alex, #store-stockholm, and #announcements, and they are out of #general and #random. Sam and Jordan are Full Members. Riley, Casey, and Jamie are the Gothenburg, Oslo, and Copenhagen managers. Use separate Chrome profiles for Sam and Jordan, and test phone mirroring for Alex. Do this before the webinar. The live demo does not include an admin invite.

manualSteps.title: Build the workflows and test them on a phone
manualSteps.detail: In Workflow Builder, create I've read the guide in #onboarding-alex and Report low stock in every store channel. I've read the guide ticks Alex's row on the New starters List. Report low stock posts in the store channel and in #nordics-stock-requests, which Alex is not in. Test both as Alex on a phone, including a photo from the camera roll, and open Onboarding - Alex, Stockholm on that phone. Then bookmark them.

manualSteps.title: Post any staged lines the tokens did not send
manualSteps.detail: Each staged message is posted as that person. Weekly reports post as Jordan until a bot token can send them as Northpeak Reports. Where a persona token is missing, sign in as that person and paste the line from the dry-run. Leave Jordan's transfer reply unsent until Alex has raised the low stock. Put a photo of a near-empty rail in Alex's camera roll before the webinar.

manualSteps.title: Pre-record Alex's beat
manualSteps.detail: Record Beat 1 on the phone as a fallback before the webinar. The live path is still Alex in Slack, with no huddle.

agentSteps.title: Confirm the Enterprise Grid org
agentSteps.detail: Use the existing Slack Enterprise+ workspace in the Frontline org. Do not create a second workspace. This demo is Slack only.

agentSteps.title: Workspace Northpeak Outdoor
agentSteps.detail: Keep the existing workspace and set its display name to Northpeak Outdoor. Leave the workspace domain as it is. The app is already installed on the Enterprise Grid org.

agentSteps.title: Create the channels
agentSteps.detail: Keep 10 channels in the existing workspace. Alex's home is onboarding-alex, store-stockholm, announcements. They are not a member of the other store channels.

agentSteps.title: Add Sam's onboarding canvas
agentSteps.detail: Create the canvas "Onboarding - Alex, Stockholm" with canvases.create as Sam, tabbed into #onboarding-alex. Frontline Members can open a canvas a Full Member shares. They do not create one.

agentSteps.title: Post the staged history
agentSteps.detail: Post each staged message with that person's user token. Weekly reports post as Jordan until a bot token can send them as Northpeak Reports. Leave Jordan's transfer reply unsent until Alex has raised the low stock.

agentSteps.title: Bookmark the workflows
agentSteps.detail: I've read the guide in #onboarding-alex, Report low stock in #store-stockholm, Report low stock in #store-gothenburg, Report low stock in #store-oslo, Report low stock in #store-copenhagen, Report low stock in #store-helsinki

agentSteps.title: Save the spec
agentSteps.detail: Write this plan to demos/northpeak-outdoor.json. Put the Slack workspace id, channel ids, and message timestamps only in demos/northpeak-outdoor.links.json.

agentSteps.title: Hand off the live demo
agentSteps.detail: Stop here. Northpeak Outdoor opens with Alex already in Slack. Do not run an admin invite on stage, and do not start a huddle.

talkTrack.label: Beat 1
talkTrack.say: Alex started this week. No company email, no sidebar of 40 channels. Just what she needs.

talkTrack.label: Beat 2
talkTrack.say: Her own onboarding channel, with her manager in it. She's just learned the rule she's about to use.

talkTrack.label: Beat 3
talkTrack.say: HQ's promo plan, on the phone in her pocket before the doors open.

talkTrack.label: Beat 4
talkTrack.say: The till knows what sold. It doesn't know the backroom is empty or that eight customers walked out without a jacket. Alex does.

talkTrack.label: Switch
talkTrack.say: Now let's see what that looks like for her store manager.

talkTrack.label: Beat 5
talkTrack.say: Sam runs every seasonal start from one view, and can see exactly who to chase before the weekend rush.

talkTrack.label: Beat 6
talkTrack.say: Sam gets last week's numbers and today's floor reality in one answer, without opening a report.

talkTrack.label: Switch
talkTrack.say: And at HQ, with 60 stores, Jordan needs the bigger picture.

talkTrack.label: Beat 7
talkTrack.say: Three stores, same jacket, same morning. That's not three problems, it's one.

talkTrack.label: Beat 8
talkTrack.say: The frontline doesn't need AI on their phones for HQ to get AI-level visibility of the floor. And the answer goes straight back to the person standing at the empty rail.

talkTrack.label: Close
talkTrack.say: One Enterprise+ security layer covers the whole workforce, with up to 10 channels per worker, accounts that expire for seasonal staff, and SCIM provisioning. The Bryd fixed-scope Frontline launch includes the Enterprise+ migration where it is needed, with a December start.
